faqs.question: What is the standard corporate credit billing window provided by Victor Mobility?
faqs.answer: Our standard corporate credit facility operates on a 30-day net settlement cycle. Monthly consolidated GST e-invoices are generated on the 1st of every month, accompanied by detailed digital trip manifests, and settled within 30 days via direct NEFT, RTGS, or automated bank ECS mandate.

faqs.question: How are billing disputes or route deviations handled under the credit facility?
faqs.answer: Every trip is backed by certified AIS-140 IoT telematics logs recording exact timestamps and GPS routes. In the rare event of a dispute, your dedicated account manager issues an immediate credit note or adjusts the invoice prior to monthly settlement.

faqs.question: Can our accounting team receive invoices broken down by departmental cost centers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our automated billing engine allows corporate clients to tag bookings with custom cost centers, employee employee IDs, or client project codes. Your monthly billing pack includes itemized department-wise Excel MIS reports alongside the legal tax invoice.

faqs.question: Are there any hidden account maintenance fees or minimum spend penalties?
faqs.answer: No. Victor Mobility corporate credit accounts have zero setup fees, zero annual maintenance charges, and no minimum spend penalties. You are billed strictly for authorized contracted retainers and booked transit services.

faqs.question: Can multinational corporations in the UAE settle invoices via corporate bank transfer (WPS/SWIFT)?
faqs.answer: Yes. Invoices can be settled directly in AED via local UAE bank transfer (direct credit / FAB / Emirates NBD) or corporate cheque under 30-day settlement terms.

faqs.question: Are Salik road tolls and airport parking fees included in the monthly credit statement?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every Salik toll gate passage and airport terminal parking receipt is electronically matched and itemized on your monthly FTA 5% VAT invoice.
